name: Stream Deck Host
description: Run Elgato Stream Deck plugins on the panel — a key grid driven by real *.sdPlugin packages.

options.label: Plugins folder
options.help: Folder on this PC holding your *.sdPlugin packages (each a folder like com.example.name.sdPlugin with a manifest.json). Plugins are real programs that run on your PC — only add plugins you trust.

options.label: Key layout
options.help: How many keys the on-screen deck shows. Matches the device size reported to plugins.
